recommended_topology: 2N3904 common emitter with unbypassed RE=100 ohm
recommended_reason: Only high-gain candidate with positive-real input and acceptable AM-01 loading; lowest end-to-end gain requirement among stable positive-input candidates

not_recommended.B: 17 ohm input collapses AM-01 output; system gain requirement 56.9 dB
not_recommended.C: CE input still loads AM-01; 12.7 pF equivalent input capacitance
not_recommended.D: High first-stage gain but 22.8 pF input and 5.14 dB loading penalty; system 35.45 dB
not_recommended.E: 3.44 pF and best raw system budget, but negative input resistance -176 ohm; not accepted without stabilization

caveats: AM-01 output loading measured with the optimized AM-01 model, not the physical board
2N3904 educational model is not the delivered transistor lot
A still has 8 pF equivalent input capacitance and 1.75 dB loading penalty
C/D/E negative-real input terms require physical verification or stabilization
No alternate transistor was accepted without a validated model and package/availability check
